# Null Handling

An attribute deliberately absent from check_function_lookup.json, so that a
"MUST conform to NullHandling requirements." sentence falls through to the
attribute-dependency path instead of being classified by the lookup.

## Requirements

NullHandling MUST adhere to the following requirements:

* NullHandling MUST treat an empty string as a value, not as null.

## Attribute ID

NullHandling

## Attribute Name

Null Handling
